positioning.audienceAppeal: People who feel not represented, restricted, and ready for change.

forbidden: Do not introduce unlisted font families.
Do not use generic default typefaces as final output.
Do not substitute fonts without a validation warning.

usage: Use official CCC logo assets only.
Use brand colors or in-paper colors depending on the template.
Do not redraw, distort, recolor outside the palette, or invent alternate marks.

guidance: Keep the message short and direct.
Use geometric blocks, bands, and sharp-edged shapes.
Do not create off-palette gradients or decorative effects.

notes: Brand guide pages use warm white backgrounds, deep navy headings, and a pale outlined CCC monogram as a background motif.
Social examples rely on hard-edged geometric blocks, high contrast navy/orange fields, compact all-caps labels, and a visible CCC mark.
Document templates use precise margins, hierarchy callouts, and restrained topic-specific graphics; policy memos explicitly prohibit visual elements.

socialRecipes.name: Primary contrast
socialRecipes.useFor: Policy alerts, CTA cards, and urgent advocacy posts
avoid: Do not combine multiple tertiary colors in large blocks.
Do not use Brick Coral and Autumn Orange as competing large panels.

socialRecipes.name: Warm editorial
socialRecipes.useFor: Quote cards, explainers, and calmer policy summaries
avoid: Do not let pale neutrals dominate the headline area.
Do not add extra accent colors when the message is text-heavy.

socialRecipes.name: Data contrast
avoid: Do not make positive and negative panels fight with unrelated accent colors.
Use one tertiary color only for data emphasis or small tags.

requiredElements: Official CCC mark or wide logo
Clear issue label or content type label
Large condensed uppercase social headline set in Anton or Montserrat Bold
CCC ring watermark or approved CCC mark motif used subtly in the background
consumerchoicecenter.org footer unless a more specific CTA is supplied
composition: Use the brand guide social post system: poster-like navy or orange fields, oversized condensed uppercase typography, orange emphasis, short labels, footer line, official CCC logo, and subtle CCC ring watermark.
Prefer one dominant field color with text blocks, strips, underlines, or compact callout chips instead of split-screen infographic panels.
For dark layouts, use Leila as the dominant background, Base White typography, Autumn Orange emphasis, and a subtle Slate Blue or Leila-tint CCC ring watermark.
For orange alert layouts, use Autumn Orange as the dominant background with stacked Leila text boxes, Base White typography, and a dark footer band.
Keep layouts poster-like and direct rather than decorative or editorial.
Avoid full-height diagonal split compositions, serif display typography, large unrelated comparison panels, soft gradients, bokeh, generic stock styling, and off-palette effects.
forbiddenComposition: Do not use large left/right split-screen fields for ordinary social posts.
Do not use full-height diagonal divider wedges as the primary composition.
Do not use serif headline typography.
Do not create placeholder logo boxes for final output.
Do not imitate a generic policy comparison infographic when the guide calls for bold CCC poster cards.

lowerThird.safeArea: Keep text and watermarks inside title/action safe areas.

policy: Final outputs must use official logo files and approved font files.
Draft placeholders are permitted only when the output mode is draft and must be reported as warnings.
Do not redraw the CCC logo as text or improvised vector art for final deliverables.

requiredLogos.usage: Primary wide logo for standard brand-color use.
CCC icon for compact marks, watermarks, and social corner placement.
Wide logo for dark navy or orange fields.

subtitles.position: Close to bottom third of the title safe action area.

horizontal.safeArea: Fit inside 4x3 center cut title safe area.

watermarks.placement: Between action and title safe areas.

strictGenerationRules: Use only colors listed in this brand data.
Use only listed typography families and weights.
Use official logo assets; if unavailable, leave a logo placeholder and flag it.
Do not invent gradients, shadows, illustrations, icons, or textures outside the brand guide.
Prefer sharp geometric vector shapes, strong contrast, and concise text.

For social posts, follow the CCC guide-style poster system: dominant Leila or Autumn Orange field, oversized condensed uppercase headline, orange emphasis, small label, subtle CCC ring watermark, footer URL, and official logo.
Do not use serif display headlines, large split-screen comparison layouts, or full-height diagonal divider wedges for social posts.
For social posts, default to 1080x1350 unless the user explicitly asks for another brand-supported size.
For policy memos, do not add decorative visual elements.
Return validation warnings before final creative output whenever required assets or fonts are missing.
